execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"
CREATE TYPE "public"."EventStatus" AS ENUM ('DRAFT', 'PUBLISH')
CREATE TYPE "public"."EventType" AS ENUM ('PUBLIC', 'PRIVATE')
CREATE TYPE "public"."Role" AS ENUM ('STUDENT', 'WORKING_PROFESSIONAL')
CREATE TYPE "public"."TeamType" AS ENUM ('INDIVIDUAL', 'TEAM', 'BOTH')

CREATE TABLE "public"."Admin" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "password" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Event" (
  "categoryId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "creatorId" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "endDate" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "eventType" "EventType" DEFAULT 'PUBLIC'::"EventType" NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isFeatured" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "location" text,
  "locationUrl" text,
  "maxTeamSize" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "minTeamSize" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "startDate" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "status" "EventStatus" DEFAULT 'DRAFT'::"EventStatus" NOT NULL,
  "subtitle" text,
  "teamType" "TeamType" DEFAULT 'INDIVIDUAL'::"TeamType" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."EventCategory" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."EventTimeline" (
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "endDate" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "eventId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "startDate" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "title" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Faq" (
  "answer" text NOT NULL,
  "eventId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "question" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ImportantLink" (
  "eventId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "url" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Partner" (
  "eventId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "logoUrl" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "websiteUrl" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Prize" (
  "amount" text,
  "description" text,
  "eventId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Registration" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "eventId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Team" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "eventId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "inviteCode" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."TeamMember" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isLeader" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "teamId" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."TeamSubmission" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "projectUrl" text,
  "teamId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "videoUrl" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Track" (
  "description" text,
  "eventId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."User" (
  "city" text,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "github" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "linkedin" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "password" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "role" "Role" DEFAULT 'STUDENT'::"Role" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "Admin_email_key" ON "public"."Admin" ("email")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "EventCategory_name_key" ON "public"."EventCategory" ("name")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "Registration_userId_eventId_key" ON "public"."Registration" ("userId", "eventId")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "Team_inviteCode_key" ON "public"."Team" ("inviteCode")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "Team_name_eventId_key" ON "public"."Team" ("name", "eventId")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "TeamMember_teamId_userId_key" ON "public"."TeamMember" ("teamId", "userId")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "TeamSubmission_teamId_key" ON "public"."TeamSubmission" ("teamId")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "User_email_key" ON "public"."User" ("email")
